name: MELD Score
template:
MELD Score (Model for End-Stage Liver Disease)

Quantifies end-stage liver disease severity for transplant prioritization

Normal: 0.7-1.3 mg/dL. Max value 4.0 used in calculation if >4.0
Normal: 0.3-1.2 mg/dL
Normal: 0.8-1.2
For MELD-Na calculation (current UNOS/OPTN standard)
Original MELD: Kamath PS et al. Hepatology 2001
MELD-Na: Current UNOS/OPTN standard since 2016
Score Range: 6-40 (scores <6 rounded to 6)
Interpretation:
• <20: 6% 3-month mortality
• 20-30: 20% 3-month mortality
• 30-40: 50% 3-month mortality
• >40: 71% 3-month mortality
